prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Path Mode Selection Grid Redesign: Redesign the journey choice screen into a balanced grid layout that visually compares play styles and daily time commitment.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Companion Journey", "body": "Select the experience style that best fits your daily desktop routine.", "replace": {"path_options": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Journey Modes", "style": "highlight", "role": "path_options"}]}}}
1: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Account Verification Tip Toast: Display an informative tip banner detailing how account authentication preserves custom pet data across re-launches.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in links your pet safely to your cloud account so your companion state is never lost.", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Your pet stays backed up across app restarts and updates.", "style": "subtle"}]}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Photo Rendering Wait Stage Redesign: Rebuild the photo creation stage with a split preview layout that displays active image processing feedback.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Crafting Your Custom Pet", "body": "Our engine is analyzing your photo and generating your desktop companion.", "replace": {"photo_upload": [{"type": "preview", "style": "rounded", "role": "photo_upload"}, {"type": "progress", "style": "highlight", "role": "photo_upload"}]}}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Adoption Certificate Celebration Flow: Insert an interactive pet spirit preview screen prior to finalizing adoption so users can test voice and animation responses.
   config: {"new_adoption_preview": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Preview Your Companion's Spirit", "body": "See how your pet responds and moves before completing the adoption form.", "components": [{"type": "animation", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "sound", "action": "play"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_adoption_preview", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Preflight Render Wait Info: Add an active time estimate and display overlay permission hints on the waiting screen while the pet engine initializes.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Preparing Desktop Companion...", "hint": "Check desktop permissions if your pet is not visible immediately."}}
5: [home, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Diagnostics Screen: Add a pre-launch diagnostic checklist screen to verify desktop overlay access and rendering status before spawning the pet.
   config: {"new_desktop_check": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Desktop Readiness Diagnostics", "body": "Verifying screen overlay permissions and graphics renderer status.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "highlight"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_check", "home_intro"]}
6: [finish, redesign] Companion Quick Controls Cheat Sheet Redesign: Redesign the home intro finish screen to display card-style control shortcuts for dragging, hiding, and talking to the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Your Companion is Live!", "body": "Right-click your pet for actions, double-click to interact, or press Esc to hide.", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Essential Shortcuts", "style": "playful", "role": "home_welcome"}]}}}
7: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Sync Reorder: Move sign-in to take place immediately after adoption certificate confirmation rather than before pet selection.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
8: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion First Interactive Quest Flow: Add an end-of-onboarding micro-quest screen guiding users to drag their desktop pet once to unlock onboarding completion.
   config: {"new_first_quest": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Complete Your First Bond", "body": "Click and drag your pet across your screen to complete setup!", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Start Interacting", "action": "next"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_first_quest"]}
9: [choose_path, hint] Path Mode Interactive Trait Hint: Add explicit contextual hints on the path choice screen clarifying how companion energy and interruption levels differ per mode.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Focus mode keeps your pet quiet in the corner; Playful mode triggers periodic desk activities.", "show_time_estimate": true}}

verdicts.reason: Loses the required job of the choose_path screen to offer both adopting and making your own pet.
Valid onboarding sign-in tip component addition under base rules.
Valid redesign of the photo upload stage preserving its core function.
Valid addition of a spirit preview flow screen within onboarding.
Valid update adding waiting screen information and time estimates.
Valid addition of a diagnostic checklist screen before home intro.
Valid redesign of home intro shortcuts layout.
Valid reordering of sign in to after adoption certificate.
Valid addition of a new interactive quest screen following home intro.
Valid addition of contextual trait hints to choose path screen.
